reviews.comment: Naraghi's the goat for 214. Lectures were great and he explained everything in an easy-to-understand way. The 3 labs were light, and homeworks aren't mandatory but are great resource for exams. The 5 Asynchronous quizzes were easy, and the textbook, homework, and lectures prepare you well for exams.

Lectures were informative and useful. Labs were an easy A however pretty tedious and not very structured. Overall very good prof who cares about the class. Test are very similar to the optional homework so take the time to do it and you will be fine.

Nice guy, gives intuitive and clear, albeit rather lengthy, lectures. The 3 labs are an easy 100 and would be enjoyable if it weren't for the broken lab equipment. There are about 5 asynchronous quizzes that are a free A. Exams are fairly predictable based on the posted HW's, but keep in mind, he posts absolutely nothing on canvas besides this.
Clear explanations during class. Useful office hours. Endless practice problems available. Cares about the understanding of students. Tests and quiz difficulty proportional to that of class examples.

He teaches well, cares about the us succeeding, and answers questions you ask in class really well. Textbook not required but used for homework, which is not graded but I recommend doing anyways. There are very few grades in this class, but this can be easy if you pay attention in lecture and keep up on the material. 10/10 would take again.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Naraghi is very knowledgeable and comes to class prepared. I have learned a lot from him. I would take him again.

His lectures are extremely conceptual and he rarely fully solves example problems, which makes the class more complicated than it needs to be. However, the first few quizzes were very similar to his homeworks (not graded). Exams were very long and you had to memorize way too many things, but I guess that's expected for any aero class

Naraghi is a good professor that I would definitely recommend.  This class is graded by few things, so take every quiz seriously. My only problems with this course are more related to the TA's than the prof, like inconsistent grading and frenetic labs. Naraghi does well answering in class questions and explaining the material.
